description: This file defines a static class OrleansJsonSerializerSettings that provides configuration and default settings for Newtonsoft.Json.JsonSerializerSettings within the Orleans framework, including methods for obtaining default settings, configuring settings with converters, and updating settings with specific options.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings
methods.description: Returns default JsonSerializerSettings with Orleans-specific configurations.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings
methods.description: Overloaded method that additionally configures settings based on provided IServiceProvider.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the provided JsonSerializerSettings by adding converters and setting the SerializationBinder if null.

methods.name: UpdateSerializerSettings
methods.description: Updates provided JsonSerializerSettings based on parameters for full assembly names, JSON indentation, and type name handling.
